summary: qds attributes LTS wording to the queried release only: each sentence gets one designation, assigned to the version mention nearest its first LTS phrase.
reason: Greptile P1s on PR #1808 (two rounds): an article or even a single sentence saying '9.8 is the LTS release' while also mentioning 9.10 marked 9.10 as LTS. Sentence bounds treat digit.digit periods as version dots; later LTS phrases in the same sentence (e.g. 'LTS support ends March 2027') describe the same designation, not a new release.
validated_outcome: TestDetectLTSForVersion covers other-release, same-sentence-both-releases, nearest-mention, and far-mention cases (misattribution cases failed before each fix); full suite and live gate repassed.
